title: Programmes offered by AIDTM
content:
### Programmes
### Academics
### Dual Degree PGDM in Big Data Analytics + Diploma in Strategic Management
Big Data Analytics is a subset of Data Sciences, a field of study in Computer Sciences and Computer Engineering.
### Dual Degree PGDM in AI & Data Science + Diploma in Strategic Management
It aims to develop professionals with a comprehensive foundation of AI & data science to solve critical real-world problems.
### Executive Program in AI, Analytics & Automation (EPAAA)
The Executive Program in AI, Analytics & Automation is a specialized program designed for professionals seeking to strengthen decision-making through analytics, artificial intelligence, and automation.
The Admissions page calls the two PGDM programmes AIDTM's "2 flagship programs" and describes both as AICTE-approved, 2-year full-time programmes.

title: PGDM in Big Data Analytics: overview
content:
PGDM (Big Data Analytics) is an AICTE-approved two-year full-time specialized program for any graduates who are passionate about shaping a career in Big Data Analytics. In the first year, students complete core courses that provide a thorough and integrated foundation in management and big data analytics essentials, plus a summer internship. In the second year, they get exposure and hands-on experience on recent technologies related to big data analytics and some elective courses of technology and management domains. Students also work on independent projects and seminars, and finally end with an industry project of 5 months. The idea behind the industry project is to leave an impact on the recruiters on the program's delivery and to give students the confidence to face real-world challenges.
### Programme Intake - 90
### Big Data Analytics
The global Big Data and business analytics market stood at US$ 307.51 billion in 2023, and is projected to grow from USD 348.21 billion in 2024 to USD 924.39 billion by 2032. Big Data Analytics is described as the fastest-growing field, with an ocean of opportunities for professionals in the global market.
The PGDM in Big Data Analytics focuses on cutting-edge tools and technologies like Big Data Analytics, Machine Learning Techniques & Applications, Python / R for Future Managers, Business Analytics, Intelligence & Forecasting, Enterprise Data Visualization, Data Warehousing and Data Mining, Deep Learning and Reinforcement Learning, Social Media and Social Networks Analytics, Time series and Forecasting Techniques & Analysis, Natural Language Processing, Blockchain Technology and Cyber Terrorism, and so on.
The acquired skills help aspirants shape their future as Data Analysts / Big Data Analysts, Data Scientists, Data Managers, Business Consultants, Data architects, Analytics associates, Analytics Managers, Business Intelligence and Analytics Consultants, Risk Analysts, Data Engineers, etc.

title: PGDM in AI & Data Science: overview
content:
PGDM (AI & DS) is an AICTE-approved two-year full-time specialized program for any graduates who are passionate about shaping career paths like Data Scientist, AI Engineer, Business Analyst, and Machine Learning Engineer. In the first year, students complete core courses that provide a strong foundation in AI, Data Science, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Predictive Analytics, plus a Summer Internship. In the second year, they get exposure and hands-on experience on recent technologies such as Gen-AI, RPA, NLP, Data Engineering and Modelling related courses of technology and management domains. Students also work on independent projects and seminars, and finally end with a capstone project of 5 months. The capstone project is meant to leave an impact on recruiters and to give students the confidence to face real-world challenges.
### Programme Intake - 60
### Artificial Intelligence & Data Science
The AI market was estimated at US$ 196.63 billion in 2023 and is projected to grow to US$ 1.87 trillion by 2032. The adoption of AI and Data Science is not limited to Computer Science; it has grown across healthcare, finance, retail, manufacturing and other industries.
The PGDM in AI & DS focuses on cutting-edge tools and technologies like Data Analytics, Machine Learning Applications, Cloud Computing Technology, Data Warehousing, Visualization, Deep Learning and Reinforcement Learning, Computer Vision, Natural Language Processing, Generative AI, and so on.
The acquired skills help aspirants shape their future as Data Scientists, AI / ML developers, AI / ML engineers, AI consultants, Data Architects, Analytics Associates, Data Analysts, AI Operations (AIOps) Engineers etc.

title: Executive Program in AI, Analytics & Automation (EPAAA): overview
content:
The Executive Program in AI, Analytics & Automation (EPAAA) is a specialized program designed for professionals seeking to strengthen decision-making through analytics, artificial intelligence, and automation. This six-month program integrates business analytics, decision science and enterprise AI with hands-on learning using tools such as Power BI, Excel, Power Apps and AI Builder. It is delivered in a flexible weekend format with online sessions and on-campus immersion, enabling participants to turn data into actionable insights and drive digital transformation.
Program highlights: designed by the best of the industry experts; self-assessment quizzes and assignments; subject matter experts from Adani Group and global experts; projects with synthetic data or the participant's own business data.
Certificate: to be awarded an EPAAA certificate, a participant must fulfil the requirements and other policies prescribed by AIDTM.
